subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should doctor adopt fixed 1 MiB AGENTS.md and 8 MiB root-memory read ceilings, with oversized root-memory migrations skipped without mutation?
rationale: The implementation and proof are sound, but selecting a permanent ceiling for a shipped persistent-memory migration determines which existing workspaces doctor will repair automatically and requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve the bounded fail-safe
options.body: Accept the proposed ceilings because they are well above documented prompt and curated-memory expectations, retain both files, and emit a clear repair-skipped note.

options.title: Choose different ceilings
options.body: Set owner-approved limits or derive a documented policy before merge while retaining the same validate-before-mutate and no-mutation failure behavior.
